app.title: Oxyris
app.tagline: Desktop coding agent — Windows + WSL, multi-session.

oxy.launch_hint: Toggle Oxy — an assistant that can see and drive every open thread
oxy.title: Oxy
oxy.listening_hint: Listening… speak your command, or say "câmbio" to send.
oxy.no_project: Open a project first — Oxy needs somewhere to run.

new_chat.title: New chat
new_chat.subtitle: Choose a project for this conversation.

sidebar.new_worktree_prompt: Branch name (new or existing) for the worktree in {{project}}:
sidebar.remove_worktree_confirm: Remove worktree "{{name}}"? The directory will be deleted from disk.

worktree_error.empty_repo: This repository has no commits yet. Create the first commit before adding a worktree.

sidebar.delete_session_confirm: Delete session "{{name}}"? Its history is kept in the event log but it disappears from the UI.

empty_state.heading: Start a new conversation
empty_state.subheading: Pick a worktree to scope this session.

project_settings_modal.title: Project settings — {{name}}
project_settings_modal.worktrees_help: Each worktree is a separate working tree on disk on its own branch. Use them to run multiple parallel sessions on the same project without stepping on each other.
project_settings_modal.remove_confirm: Remove worktree "{{name}}"? The directory will be deleted from disk.
project_settings_modal.logo_help: Pick an image file or let Oxyris auto-detect a logo from common locations (logo.png, assets/logo.svg, public/icon.png, etc).
project_settings_modal.logo_autodetect_empty: No logo found in common locations. Pick a file manually.
project_settings_modal.workspace_help: Group this project under a workspace/vault (e.g. Personal, Acme Corp). Leave empty to keep it ungrouped. The sidebar selector filters by these.
project_settings_modal.delete_help: Remove this project from Oxyris. The working tree on disk is not touched — only Oxyris forgets about it.
project_settings_modal.delete_confirm: Delete project "{{name}}" from Oxyris? Its files on disk are left untouched.

welcome.title: Welcome to Oxyris
welcome.tagline: A desktop coding agent for Windows and WSL with parallel Claude sessions.
welcome.check_claude_missing_detail: Run `claude auth login` in any environment you plan to use, then click Refresh in Settings.
welcome.next_body: Pick a folder on Windows or inside a WSL distro. Each project can host multiple parallel sessions on separate git worktrees.
welcome.shortcut_hint: Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+N opens this anywhere in the app. Esc interrupts the current turn.
